title: FR-LLM: Multi-task large language model with signal-to-text encoding and adaptive optimization for joint fault diagnosis and RUL prediction
abstract: FR-LLM unifies fault diagnosis and remaining useful life prediction. It converts vibration features into structured text, uses adaptive task-loss balancing to reduce multi-task conflicts, and applies low-rank adaptation for efficient training.
summary: 统一完成故障诊断与 RUL 预测，重点关注信号文本化、多任务损失平衡和低秩适配。

title: A sample-efficient transfer learning framework for industrial remaining useful life prediction leveraging large language models
abstract: The framework combines a transferable large-language-model backbone with dual-score sample selection to improve RUL learning under high-dimensional, multi-condition sensor data and limited labels.
summary: 用可迁移 LLM 骨干和双评分样本选择提高多工况、小样本 RUL 预测效率。

title: PEFT-MuTS: A Multivariate Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Framework for Remaining Useful Life Prediction based on Cross-domain Time Series Representation Model
abstract: PEFT-MuTS adapts a frozen cross-domain univariate time-series representation model to few-shot multivariate RUL prediction through independent feature tuning, low-rank meta-variable fusion, and a zero-initialized regressor.
summary: 将跨域单变量时序预训练骨干高效适配到多变量少样本 RUL，并用零初始化回归头提高微调稳定性。

title: Exploring Prior-Structured Low-Rank Adaptation for Predictive Maintenance based on Time Series Foundation Model
abstract: A Prior-Structured Adapter augments a frozen Timer-XL foundation model with frequency-enhanced and degradation-trajectory priors. A condition-aware gate adjusts adapter strength for diagnosis and RUL tasks.
summary: 在冻结的 Timer-XL 上，用频率先验、退化轨迹先验和工况门控构造面向预测性维护的低秩适配器。
